title: Jaya Trono ukan Enigma ukan uñt’ayata
intro: Mä chʼamani reyijja, wali chʼamani apnaqäwimpiw bendicitäna, jupajj mä muspharkañ jan waltʼäwinwa uñjasïna, ukanjja jaya markat jutir mä reinaw utjäna. Uka reyix Diosan chʼamapa ukat yatiñap uñachtʼayañ munäna, ukat mä jan iyawsañjam suceso uñstayäna, ukax tiempo ukat espacio kamachinakar jan yäqasa. ¿Uka milagrojj kunjamsa pasäna uk sum amuytʼasmati?
clues: Mä apnaqirirojj wali chʼamanïpjjänwa, jan uñjkañ jaqenakar apnaqañapataki ukat thayanakar apnaqañ yatiñapataki.
Aka apnaqirix mä qamir reinat yatiyaw katuqatayna, jupax intiruw yupaychatayna, ukat tribunalar jawst’añ amtäna.
Janïr reina purinkipanxa, apnaqirix jaya reinopat jach’a apnaqañ asientop apaniñ munatap uñacht’ayäna.
Mä ch’aman jinnix janïr apnaqirix conciliopat sartaskipanx uka yänak apsuñaw sasaw säna.
Ukampis Diosan Qellqatapat wali uñtʼat jaqejja, jukʼamp jankʼakiw apsuñ munäna, ukat mä chʼipjjtasaw uka lurañ tukuyäna.
Ukar purisax apnaqirix uka yäx mayjt’ayañapatakiw mayïna, ukhamat reinax palacion qhiparu purinkäna ukhax amuyt’asiñapataki ukat amuyt’añapataki.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
